pooled_caveat: Reproductive policy is central, but the cluster also contains broader equality and family-policy claims; positions differ within and across documents over rights, funding, and institutions.
pooled_summary: The central claims concern abortion and reproductive health, contraception, gender and sexual equality, family recognition, caregiving, and protections against discrimination or violence. The packet includes direct conflicts over reproductive autonomy, fetal life, public funding, judicial doctrine, and the legal definition of family and sex.
qualification: Source-bound assistant synthesis of period- and document-diverse central examples, not independent human certification or an exhaustive stance classification. Statements describe the observed documents across years, not every member's beliefs or a current consensus.
title: Reproductive Rights, Gender Equality, and Family Policy
